title: Whisker Chunks
description: A paid message from Whisker Chunks, the meatiest mystery chow this side of the Rio Grande.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-cat
lines.text: Weeell howdy there, partner! <p:0.2> Out here on the lonesome prairie, every cat deserves a hearty supper at the end of a long cattle drive.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-cat
lines.text: Whisker Chunks is the meatiest mystery chow this side of the Rio Grande! <p:0.2> Round up the herd, fill the trough, and watch them varmints chow down!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Whisker Chunks may contain cat. <p:0> Not for cats. <p:0> Or horses. <p:0> Side effects include hairballs the size of tumbleweeds. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
